name: Valentina Herrera
bio:
Valentina's fascination with motorsport began during her childhood in Buenos Aires, where she spent countless hours watching Formula 1 races with her grandfather. This passion led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, Valentina secured an internship at a local racing team, where she gained hands-on experience in wind tunnel testing and data analysis. 

Her approach to wind tunnel operations is methodical and detail-oriented, ensuring accurate and reliable data collection. She believes that even the smallest adjustments can make a significant difference in a car's performance. Valentina is eager to expand her knowledge and contribute to a winning team. 

What sets Valentina apart is her unwavering commitment to continuous improvement and her innate ability to identify subtle aerodynamic inefficiencies. She is a valuable asset to any team looking to gain a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Valentina is of average height with a determined gaze and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas during wind tunnel tests.
Has a habit of humming quietly while analyzing data, a habit she's unaware of.
Prefers to calibrate the wind tunnel equipment herself to ensure accuracy, even if it's not her primary responsibility.
